name: From Port to Port
summary: A port seller sends you with a carefully packed cask to Feathermoon Stronghold. The long journey calls for care.

sections.title: A Distant Customer
sections.body: A seller has a customer at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas, and you carry a cask of Powderfuse Port there. The seller says it is packed airtight, but warns that something could set it off. Handle the cask with care on the way to Mardrack Greenwell.

faq.answer: You are carrying a cask of Powderfuse Port to Mardrack Greenwell at Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Where am I taking the cask?
faq.answer: The cask is bound for Mardrack Greenwell at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

faq.q: Why should I handle it carefully?
faq.answer: The seller warns that something could set off the airtight-packed cask.
One of the seller's men packed the cask airtight.
